mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name = #{name}, gender = CASE WHEN #{gender} = '男' THEN 1 WHEN #{gender} = '女' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, age = #{age}, university = #{university}, major = #{major} WHERE username = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(name, '') AS name, CASE gender WHEN 1 THEN '男' WHEN 2 THEN '女' ELSE '' END AS gender, COALESCE(age, 0) AS age, COALESCE(university, '') AS university, COALESCE(major, '') AS major FROM user WHERE username = #{username}
